sulfurCube.title: Sulfur cube launch mechanics
sulfurCube.scope: Java Edition 26.2 mechanics · selected cube properties · one ordinary direct non-projectile knockback call · cube initially at rest
sulfurCube.assumptions.title: Scope and fixed assumptions
sulfurCube.assumptions.intro: This view keeps the following assumptions fixed:
sulfurCube.assumptions.call: The attack makes one ordinary damage knockback call with effect factor E = 1.
sulfurCube.assumptions.cube: The adult sulfur cube starts at rest and uses its JE 26.2 dimensions and the selected properties. The default state places its feet at (0, 0, 0).
sulfurCube.assumptions.aim: The aim point constructs the attacker's look direction; it is not a sampled collision point.
sulfurCube.assumptions.trajectory: The trajectory is an illustrative airborne free-flight continuation beginning with the first cube movement update after the impulse. It excludes collisions, bouncing, fluids, and later attacks.
sulfurCube.invalidInputs: Enter valid cube properties and finite scene inputs, use a whole-number trajectory horizon from 0 to 200 ticks, and keep the aim point distinct from the eye position.
sulfurCube.controls.title: Inputs
sulfurCube.properties.title: Cube properties
sulfurCube.properties.modeHelp: Choose a swallowed block, a technical property definition, or detached custom values.
sulfurCube.properties.absorbedBlockHelp: Search the 334 block items accepted by the vanilla JE 26.2 sulfur cube. Matching uses the absorbed item, not block state.
sulfurCube.properties.archetypeHelp: A technical JE 26.2 sulfur-cube registry entry, not a localized block category.
sulfurCube.properties.customHelp: Custom values are a detached copy. They persist when you leave Custom mode or change the selected block or definition.
sulfurCube.properties.copyResolvedHelp: Current locked source: {source}. Copying replaces the saved Custom values.
sulfurCube.properties.customInvalid: Enter finite values, keep knockback resistance from −2 to 1, and keep the air-drag modifier from 0 to 2048.
sulfurCube.properties.lockedHelp: These source-resolved values are locked. Choose Custom to edit a detached copy.
sulfurCube.controls.damageArgumentHelp: The nonnegative damage value passed to this knockback call; this is not necessarily health lost.
sulfurCube.controls.coordinatesHelp: Use these fields as an alternative to the scene handles or to edit lateral X/Z coordinates outside the radial view.
sulfurCube.controls.cubeFeetHelp: World coordinates of the bottom center of the sulfur cube.
sulfurCube.controls.attackerFeetHelp: World coordinates used for the cube-to-attacker elevation calculation and horizontal base direction.
sulfurCube.controls.attackerEyesHelp: World coordinates supplied independently from the feet position. The default uses the standing-player eye height of 1.62 blocks; editing these coordinates is a diagnostic override of that relationship.
sulfurCube.controls.aimPointHelp: Defines look direction from the eye position. It does not represent where the attack collided with the cube.
sulfurCube.controls.trajectoryTicksHelp: A whole number from 0 to 200 ticks. Default chooses the first airborne movement update that puts the cube at least two blocks below its starting height; this does not simulate collisions or bounces.
sulfurCube.scene.svgDescription: A pannable and zoomable radial side view showing the sulfur cube, the standing player's hitbox, feet and eyes, a fixed-length look arrow, launch velocity, and the first part of the calculated airborne free-flight trajectory.
sulfurCube.scene.aimHandleAria: Move aim point, currently x {x}, y {y}, z {z}. Arrow keys move by 0.25 blocks; hold Shift for 0.05-block steps.
sulfurCube.scene.attackerHandleAria: Move the attacker while preserving eye height and look direction. Arrow keys move by 0.25 blocks; hold Shift for 0.05-block steps.
sulfurCube.scene.cubeHandleAria: Move the sulfur cube by its center handle. Arrow keys move by 0.25 blocks; hold Shift for 0.05-block steps.
sulfurCube.scene.interactionHelp: Drag an object handle to move only that input, drag the empty background to pan, and scroll over the scene or use −/+ to zoom.
sulfurCube.scene.projectionHelp: This side-view plane initially places the player to the left of the cube and stays fixed while objects move. Lateral X/Z values remain part of the full 3D calculation even when invisible here; the numeric mechanics and θ arc use that full 3D geometry.
sulfurCube.scene.trajectoryTruncated: The scene shows the first {shown} of {requested} requested ticks to keep the launch geometry readable; the detailed result still evaluates the full horizon.
sulfurCube.power.title: How aim and height determine launch power
sulfurCube.power.subtitle: Internal horizontal/vertical power space—not world-space velocity.
sulfurCube.power.svgDescription: A diagram showing the selected base power, vertical aim transfer, feet-elevation rotation, and component-ratio cap inside the horizontal and vertical power axes.
sulfurCube.power.stages.baseHelp: The selected cube properties' starting horizontal and vertical powers.
sulfurCube.power.stages.aimHelp: Vertical aim redistributes power between the two components using q.
sulfurCube.power.stages.elevationHelp: Relative attacker-feet elevation rotates the aim-adjusted pair by −0.8θ.
sulfurCube.power.stages.cappedHelp: The pair is scaled together when either archetype-relative component magnitude exceeds its limit.
sulfurCube.power.capApplied: The component cap is active here: at least one rotated component magnitude exceeds its archetype limit, so the pair is multiplied by {factor} to reach the final internal power.
sulfurCube.power.capNotApplied: The rotated pair is already within both component limits, so the cap does not rescale it.
sulfurCube.power.aimTransferExplanation: Aim applies a {percentage}% transfer ratio: horizontal power is multiplied by {horizontalFactor}, while vertical power is multiplied by {verticalFactor}.
sulfurCube.power.rotationExplanation: Height then rotates the aim-adjusted pair by {degrees}°.
sulfurCube.readout.title: Calculated launch
sulfurCube.readout.finalPosition: Cube feet position after horizon (x, y, z)
sulfurCube.readout.provenanceBehavior: Knockback behavior is derived from locally decompiled Java Edition 26.2 code.
sulfurCube.readout.provenanceData: Resolved source properties and sulfur cube dimensions are derived from Java Edition 26.2 data and runtime initialization; Custom mode clearly separates reader-edited values.
sulfurCube.readout.standardMath: This version uses standard TypeScript number and trigonometric operations; source-precision emulation is planned separately.
